description: The Vision Area Rug Collection features sophisticated, soft tone-on-tone area rugs, perfectly styled to energize today's urban-chic contemporary decor. Rich solid colors woven into a soft white pile add dimension and texture to the flowing, abstract lines of color that radiate from every rug in this dazzling Collection.
